use System.Text.StringBuilder

text = "hello, {text}"

fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Text.StringBuilder

let text mut = "world"

text = "hello, {text}"

write_line(text)

let built = StringBuilder("world")

built.insert(0, "hello, ")

write_line("{built}")
